title: nan
authors: Ahmedelbadawi H.; Żugaj M.; González-Moreno M.T.; Moreno Cuenca L.
key_contribution: Presents a vision-based UAV localization framework using multi-modal terrain data (DSM, slope, aspect, VRM) and stereo vision for GNSS-denied georeferenced matching, achieving 30% drift reduction.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
